title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to convert Month Name (Text) to Month Number (Integer)
summary: Converting a month name text value to its corresponding month number integer is possible using the GetLocalizedMonthToInt method from the standard Type Helper codeunit. This functionality is useful when you need to transform text representations of months like 'January' into numeric values like 1.
key_points: Type Helper codeunit provides the built-in GetLocalizedMonthToInt procedure for this conversion
The method accepts a text parameter containing the month name and returns an integer
This is a simple, standard approach that requires minimal code implementation
Useful for scenarios requiring numeric month values from textual inputs

quotes.text: a standard method already exists for this. codeunit 10 "Type Helper" -> procedure GetLocalizedMonthToInt
quotes.why_it_matters: It identifies the exact built-in method and location for solving the month conversion problem without custom development.
